name: MenuMax – Digital Restaurant Menus
author: Polar Line Services LLC

sections.description:
MenuMax – Digital Restaurant Menus is the ultimate WordPress plugin for restaurants, cafes, bars, and food businesses to create beautiful, professional digital menus that work perfectly on all devices.

Transform your website into a complete digital menu solution with our easy-to-use menu builder. Whether you run a restaurant, cafe, food truck, catering business, bar, or bakery, MenuMax helps you showcase your offerings elegantly and efficiently.

🌟 Why Choose MenuMax?

MenuMax simplifies digital menu creation for WordPress websites. No coding required – just drag, drop, and publish beautiful menus that engage customers and drive sales.

Perfect for:

  • 🍽️ Restaurants and fine dining establishments

  • ☕ Coffee shops and cafes

  • 🍕 Pizzerias and fast food restaurants

  • 🚚 Food trucks and pop-up vendors

  • 🎂 Bakeries and dessert shops

  • 🍹 Bars and breweries

  • 🥘 Catering companies

  • 🏨 Hotels and resorts

✨ Key Features

Easy Menu Management

  • Custom post types for organizing Menus and Menu Items

  • Intuitive drag-and-drop interface for menu organization

  • Bulk import/export functionality for easy backup and migration

  • Simple shortcode integration – add menus anywhere on your site

Professional Design

  • 📱 100% mobile-responsive and touch-friendly design

  • 🖼️ Support for high-quality menu item images

  • 🎨 Customizable colors, backgrounds, and layouts

  • 💡 Clean, modern design that matches any WordPress theme

  • 📐 Flexible column layouts (1, 2, or 3 columns)

E-Commerce Integration

  • 🛒 Direct WooCommerce product linking

  • 💰 Multi-currency support for international businesses

  • 🔗 Turn menu items into clickable product links

  • 💳 Seamless online ordering integration

Business Tools

  • 📊 Export menus as JSON for backup purposes

  • 📥 Import menus from JSON files for quick setup

  • 🔄 Easy menu duplication and migration between sites

  • ⚙️ Centralized settings dashboard

🚀 How It Works

  1. Create Your Menu – Add a new menu from the MenuMax dashboard

  2. Add Menu Items – Create items with titles, descriptions, prices, and images

  3. Organize – Drag and drop items to arrange your perfect menu layout

  4. Customize – Set currency symbols, colors, and display options

  5. Publish – Use the shortcode to display menus on any page or post

  6. Optional – Link items to WooCommerce products for online ordering

📱 Perfect for QR Code Menus

Create contactless digital menus perfect for QR codes! Customers can scan and view your menu on their phones instantly. Ideal for:

  • Contactless dining experiences

  • Table-side menu access

  • Takeout and delivery menu displays

  • Social distancing compliance

🔗 WooCommerce Integration

Seamlessly connect your menu items to your WooCommerce store. When customers click a menu item, they’re taken directly to the product page where they can add items to their cart and complete their order.

Perfect for:

  • Online food ordering

  • Restaurant delivery services

  • Takeout and pickup orders

  • Catering order forms

💼 Professional Support

Built by Polar Line Services LLC, a trusted WordPress development agency specializing in restaurant and hospitality solutions.

Need custom features or professional setup? Contact our team for expert WordPress development services.

🎯 SEO-Friendly Menus

MenuMax creates search engine optimized menus that help customers find your restaurant online. Proper HTML structure and semantic markup ensure your menu items are discoverable by search engines.

🆓 Free Forever

MenuMax core features are completely free. We believe every restaurant deserves professional digital menus.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard

  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New

  3. Search for “MenuMax Digital Restaurant Menus”

  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file

  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard

  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin

  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now

  5. Click Activate Plugin

Getting Started

  1. After activation, navigate to MenuMax in your WordPress dashboard

  2. Click Menu Items to create your first menu item with title, description, price, and image

  3. Go to Menus and create a new menu

  4. Select which menu items to include and arrange them by dragging and dropping

  5. Copy your menu’s ID number

  6. Use the shortcode [crm_menu id="YOUR_MENU_ID"] on any page or post

  7. Customize display with optional parameters:

  • columns="2" – Display in 2 columns (default: 1)

  • background="#f9f9f9" – Set background color (default: #f9f9f9)

  • background="none" – Remove background and box shadow

Example Shortcode:

[crm_menu id="123" columns="2" background="#ffffff"]

Optional: WooCommerce Integration

  1. Install and activate WooCommerce plugin

  2. Create WooCommerce products

  3. Edit any Menu Item in MenuMax

  4. Select the linked WooCommerce product from the dropdown

  5. Menu items will now link to product pages on your site

Import/Export Menus

Export:

  1. Go to MenuMax > Settings

  2. Click Export Menus

  3. Download the JSON file

Import:

  1. Go to MenuMax > Settings

  2. Click Import Menus

  3. Upload your JSON file

  4. All menus and items will be imported

Need help? Visit our support page or check our documentation.
sections.faq:
How do I display a menu on my site?

Use the shortcode [crm_menu id="X"] on any page or post, replacing “X” with your menu ID (found in the MenuMax > Menus list). You can customize the display with additional parameters like columns="2" and background="#f9f9f9".

Can I customize the menu appearance?

Yes! You can customize:

  • Background colors using the background shortcode parameter

  • Currency symbols in the MenuMax settings

  • Number of columns (1, 2, or 3)

  • Remove backgrounds by setting background="none"

More customization options are coming in future updates!

Is MenuMax mobile responsive?

Absolutely! MenuMax is built with mobile-first design principles. Your menus will look beautiful on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers. The layout automatically adjusts for optimal viewing on any screen size.

Does MenuMax work with WooCommerce?

Yes! MenuMax seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce. You can link any menu item to a WooCommerce product, turning your digital menu into a powerful online ordering system. Customers click the menu item and go directly to the product page to add items to their cart.

Can I use MenuMax for a QR code menu?

Perfect for QR menus! Simply create your menu, publish it on a page, and generate a QR code linking to that page. Customers can scan the code with their phones to view your contactless digital menu.

How do I add prices to menu items?

When creating or editing a Menu Item, you’ll see a “Price” field in the sidebar. Enter the numeric price (without currency symbol). The currency symbol you set in MenuMax > Settings will be displayed automatically.

Can I have multiple menus?

Yes! Create unlimited menus for different purposes:

  • Lunch menu

  • Dinner menu

  • Drinks menu

  • Dessert menu

  • Kids menu

  • Seasonal specials

Each menu gets its own unique ID for the shortcode.

How does import/export work?

Export creates a JSON file containing all your menus, items, prices, descriptions, and settings. Use it for:

  • Backup – Save your menu data safely

  • Migration – Move menus between websites

  • Duplication – Clone menus for similar restaurants

Import uploads a JSON file and recreates all menus and items on your site.

Do I need coding knowledge?

Not at all! MenuMax is designed for restaurant owners and managers with no technical background. The intuitive interface makes menu creation as easy as filling out a form.

Will MenuMax slow down my website?

No. MenuMax is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only loads the necessary CSS and JavaScript on pages where menus are displayed.

Can I translate MenuMax?

Yes! MenuMax is translation-ready and works with popular translation plugins like WPML and Polylang. You can create multilingual menus for international customers.

Where can I get support?

  • Documentation: polarlineservices.com/menumax-digital-restaurant-menus

  • Support Forum: WordPress.org support forum

  • Professional Support: Contact Polar Line Services

How can I contribute or request features?

We love feedback! Contact us with feature requests or visit our development roadmap.
